helpers_sql:
-- Install once on PostgreSQL in a schema controlled by the application owner.
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS fdd;
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fdd.try_double(value text)
RETURNS double precision
LANGUAGE plpgsql IMMUTABLE STRICT PARALLEL SAFE
AS $$
BEGIN
  RETURN trim(value)::double precision;
EXCEPTION
  WHEN invalid_text_representation OR numeric_value_out_of_range THEN RETURN NULL;
END;
$$;

-- Sensor sweep assessability (twin of pandas sensor_sweep_catalog). Long-form inputs are SI only:
-- each sample is assessed only when its declared unit matches the role's SI quantity. Any other
-- unit, or none, masks that sample; nothing is converted or guessed here.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fdd.norm_unit(value text)
RETURNS text
LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE AS $$
  SELECT lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(btrim(value), ''), '[^a-zA-Z0-9]', '', 'g'));
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fdd.quantity_for_sql_role(role text)
RETURNS text
LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE AS $$
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN btrim(role) IN ('ahu_sat', 'chw_return_t', 'chw_supply_sp', 'chw_supply_t',
      'cooling_coil_entering_temp', 'cooling_coil_leaving_temp', 'cooling_sp', 'cw_return_t',
      'cw_supply_t', 'heating_coil_entering_temp', 'heating_coil_leaving_temp', 'heating_sp',
      'hw_return_t', 'hw_supply_t', 'mat', 'oa_t', 'preheat_leave_t', 'rat', 'sat', 'sat_sp',
      'vav_discharge_t', 'vav_inlet_t', 'web_oa_dp', 'web_oa_t', 'web_wb_t', 'zone_air_temp_sp', 'zone_t')
      THEN 'absolute_temperature'
    WHEN btrim(role) IN ('ma_h', 'oa_h', 'ra_h', 'sa_h', 'web_oa_h', 'zone_rh')
      THEN 'relative_humidity'
    WHEN btrim(role) IN ('chw_dp', 'chw_dp_sp', 'duct_static', 'duct_static_sp') THEN 'air_pressure'
    WHEN btrim(role) IN ('chw_flow', 'min_flow_sp', 'vav_total_flow', 'zone_airflow_sp', 'zone_flow') THEN 'volume_flow'
    WHEN btrim(role) IN ('chiller_power', 'electric_kw') THEN 'power'
    WHEN btrim(role) IN ('electric_kwh', 'kwh') THEN 'energy'
    WHEN btrim(role) IN ('chiller_amps', 'chiller_current') THEN 'electric_current'
    WHEN btrim(role) = 'zone_co2' THEN 'concentration'
    WHEN btrim(role) IN ('chw_reset_request_sum', 'hw_reset_request_sum', 'static_reset_request') THEN 'count'
    ELSE NULL
  END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fdd.unit_declares_quantity(unit text, quantity text)
RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE AS $$
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN unit IS NULL OR btrim(unit) = '' THEN false
    WHEN quantity = 'absolute_temperature' THEN
      fdd.norm_unit(unit) IN ('c', 'degc', 'celsius')
    WHEN quantity = 'relative_humidity' THEN
      fdd.norm_unit(unit) IN ('pct', 'percent', 'rh', 'percentrelativehumidity')
      OR position('%' IN unit) > 0
    WHEN quantity = 'air_pressure' THEN
      fdd.norm_unit(unit) IN ('pa', 'pascal')
    WHEN quantity = 'volume_flow' THEN
      fdd.norm_unit(unit) = 'ls'
    WHEN quantity = 'power' THEN
      fdd.norm_unit(unit) = 'kw'
    WHEN quantity = 'energy' THEN
      fdd.norm_unit(unit) = 'kwh'
    WHEN quantity = 'electric_current' THEN
      fdd.norm_unit(unit) = 'a'
    WHEN quantity = 'concentration' THEN
      fdd.norm_unit(unit) = 'ppm'
    WHEN quantity = 'count' THEN
      fdd.norm_unit(unit) = 'count'
    ELSE false
  END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fdd.is_expected_constant_sql_role(role text)
RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE AS $$
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN btrim(role) = '' THEN false
    WHEN fdd.norm_unit(role) LIKE '%sp' THEN true
    WHEN position('setpoint' IN fdd.norm_unit(role)) > 0 THEN true
    WHEN position('status' IN fdd.norm_unit(role)) > 0 THEN true
    WHEN fdd.norm_unit(role) LIKE '%cmd' THEN true
    WHEN position('command' IN fdd.norm_unit(role)) > 0 THEN true
    WHEN fdd.norm_unit(role) = 'occmode' THEN true
    WHEN position('occupied' IN fdd.norm_unit(role)) > 0 THEN true
    WHEN position('occupancy' IN fdd.norm_unit(role)) > 0 THEN true
    WHEN fdd.norm_unit(role) = 'loopenabled' THEN true
    ELSE false
  END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fdd.sweep_assessable_sql_role(role text, unit text)
RETURNS boolean
LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE AS $$
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN fdd.is_expected_constant_sql_role(role) THEN false
    ELSE fdd.unit_declares_quantity(unit, fdd.quantity_for_sql_role(role))
  END;
$$;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION fdd.mask_sweep_val(role text, unit text, val double precision)
RETURNS double precision
LANGUAGE sql IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE AS $$
  SELECT CASE WHEN fdd.sweep_assessable_sql_role(role, unit) THEN val ELSE NULL END;
$$;

FAN-RUNTIME-HOURS.sql:
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- fan_runtime_hours.sql
-- Fan runtime integrates the forward delta while fan_cmd > 0.05.
-- A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown and is omitted from both totals.
-- The last sample does not invent a trailing interval.

WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    fan_cmd AS fan_cmd,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
      - timestamp_utc
    )) AS dt_seconds
  FROM history
),
held AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    fan_cmd,
    CASE
      WHEN dt_seconds IS NULL OR dt_seconds <= 0.0 OR dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds
  FROM ordered
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fan_cmd > 0.05 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fan_runtime_hours,
  SUM(CASE WHEN fan_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS total_hours
FROM held
GROUP BY equipment_id;
FAN-RUNTIME-HOURS.timeline_reason: no per-row confirmed flag (the rule aggregates a ratio, count or window statistic)

VAV-1.sql:
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- vav1_comfort_fault.sql — zone comfort band with confirm window (Open-FDD parity)
-- When occ_mode is present, require_occupied (default 1) scores the band only
-- while occupied. The rule runner synthesizes occ_mode from the saved Overview
-- calendar (session occupancy_schedule) when no modeled occ_mode exists.
-- With neither signal, the product path reports NOT_ASSESSED_NO_OCCUPANCY (0 fault
-- seconds). Unoccupied setback stays on VAV-2.
-- OFDD-065: do not reference fan_cmd here. Zone-only parquet schemas
-- often lack fan_cmd; DataFusion then schema-errors → SKIPPED_MISSING_ROLES.
WITH h AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    zone_t,
    occ_mode,
    CAST(CASE WHEN zone_t < 21.111111111 OR zone_t > 23.888888889 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT) AS band_fault
  FROM history
  WHERE zone_t IS NOT NULL
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN 1 >= 0.5
       AND occ_mode IS NOT NULL
       AND (
         LOWER(trim(CAST(occ_mode AS VARCHAR))) IN
           ('unoccupied','unocc','off','false','night','standby','setback','no')
         OR (
           fdd.try_double(trim(CAST(occ_mode AS VARCHAR))) IS NOT NULL
           AND fdd.try_double(trim(CAST(occ_mode AS VARCHAR))) <= 0.05
         )
       )
      THEN 0
      ELSE band_fault
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM h
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    timestamp_utc,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS fault_pct
FROM final
GROUP BY equipment_id;

ZONE-COMFORT-PCT.sql:
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- zone_comfort_pct.sql
-- Comfort is the share of eligible elapsed time inside the band, not a row count.
-- Band placeholders ZONE_T_LO / ZONE_T_HI and history zone_t are SI °C (metric pack).
WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    zone_t,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
      - timestamp_utc
    )) AS dt_seconds
  FROM history
  WHERE zone_t IS NOT NULL
),
held AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    zone_t,
    CASE
      WHEN dt_seconds IS NULL OR dt_seconds <= 0.0 OR dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds
  FROM ordered
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE
    WHEN zone_t >= 20 AND zone_t <= 24.444444444 THEN held_seconds
    ELSE 0.0
  END) / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS comfort_pct
FROM held
GROUP BY equipment_id;

FAULT-ELAPSED-HOURS.sql:
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- fault_elapsed_hours.sql — comfort fault elapsed rollup
-- Storage is SI (metric-c-v2): zone_t and ZONE_T_LO / ZONE_T_HI are °C.
-- Out-of-band zone temperature holds forward until the next sample.
-- Gaps longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS are unknown (not fault, not covered).
WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    zone_t,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
      - timestamp_utc
    )) AS dt_seconds
  FROM history
  WHERE zone_t IS NOT NULL
),
held AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    zone_t,
    CASE
      WHEN dt_seconds IS NULL OR dt_seconds <= 0.0 OR dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds
  FROM ordered
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN zone_t < 20 OR zone_t > 24.444444 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fault_samples,
  SUM(CASE
    WHEN zone_t < 20 OR zone_t > 24.444444 THEN held_seconds
    ELSE 0.0
  END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE
    WHEN zone_t < 20 OR zone_t > 24.444444 THEN held_seconds
    ELSE 0.0
  END) / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS fault_pct
FROM held
GROUP BY equipment_id;

OAT-METEO.sql:
-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- oat_meteo_fault.sql — BAS OAT vs meteo reference (|Δ| > threshold) + confirm
-- Storage is SI (metric-c-v2): oa_t and the web reference are °C; OAT_ERR is a temperature difference in K.
-- Web weather is joined as-of: carry the last web sample forward up to
-- WEB_ASOF_BOUND_SECONDS (web cadence + margin from registry). Beyond that bound
-- the local sample is not compared (not-assessed seconds, never a no-fault).
-- Prefer equipment web_oa_t (matches the reference oracle); fall back to weather rows when absent.
-- Targeting is registry equipment_kinds (ahu) plus the package stamp applied
-- after this query. This file does not filter equipment_id by prefix or LIKE.
WITH web_points AS (
  SELECT timestamp_utc, web_oa_t AS ref_val
  FROM weather
  WHERE web_oa_t IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT timestamp_utc, web_oa_t AS ref_val
  FROM history
  WHERE web_oa_t IS NOT NULL
),
web_dedup AS (
  SELECT timestamp_utc, MAX(ref_val) AS ref_val
  FROM web_points
  GROUP BY timestamp_utc
),
web_intervals AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp_utc AS ref_ts,
    ref_val,
    LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp_utc) AS next_ref_ts
  FROM web_dedup
),
joined AS (
  SELECT
    h.equipment_id,
    h.timestamp_utc,
    h.oa_t,
    CAST(wi.ref_ts AS timestamptz) AS ref_ts,
    CAST(wi.ref_val AS double precision) AS ref_oa_t,
    CASE
      WHEN h.oa_t IS NULL THEN false
      WHEN wi.ref_val IS NULL THEN false
      WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (h.timestamp_utc - wi.ref_ts)) > 1500
      THEN false
      ELSE true
    END AS assessable
  FROM history h
  LEFT JOIN web_intervals wi
    ON h.timestamp_utc >= wi.ref_ts
   AND (wi.next_ref_ts IS NULL OR h.timestamp_utc < wi.next_ref_ts)
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    assessable,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN NOT assessable THEN NULL
      WHEN ABS(oa_t - ref_oa_t) > 2.777778 THEN 1
      ELSE 0 END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM joined
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN NOT assessable THEN 0.0
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL

      WHEN h.zone_flow IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN h.zone_flow > 23.597350 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN h.pump_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN h.pump_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN h.chw_pump_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN h.chw_pump_cmd > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN h.chiller_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN h.chiller_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 1 END AS energized
  FROM history h
),
equipment_summary AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM timestamp_utc)) AS observed_end_epoch,
    100.0 * AVG(energized) AS coverage_pct
  FROM base_proof
  GROUP BY equipment_id
),
sensor_series AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role
  FROM sensor_history
  GROUP BY equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role
),
sensor_rows AS (
  SELECT s.equipment_id, s.series_id, s.sensor_role, s.timestamp_utc,
    CASE WHEN hs.observed_end_epoch IS NULL OR MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.equipment_id) > hs.observed_end_epoch
      THEN MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.equipment_id) ELSE hs.observed_end_epoch END AS observed_end_epoch,
    COALESCE(hs.coverage_pct, 100.0) AS coverage_pct,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM s.timestamp_utc) AS epoch_seconds,
    CASE WHEN s.sensor_role IN ('oa_t', 'mat', 'zone_t', 'rat', 'sat')
      THEN fdd.mask_sweep_val(s.sensor_role, s.unit, s.value) ELSE NULL END AS value
  FROM sensor_history s
  LEFT JOIN equipment_summary hs
    ON hs.equipment_id = s.equipment_id
  WHERE s.value IS NOT NULL
),
prior AS (
  SELECT sensor_rows.*,
    LAG(value) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds) AS previous_value,
    COALESCE(LEAD(epoch_seconds) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds), observed_end_epoch) AS next_epoch,
    LAG(epoch_seconds) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds) AS previous_epoch
  FROM sensor_rows
),
prior_groups AS (
  SELECT prior.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN value IS NULL OR previous_value IS NULL OR previous_epoch IS NULL
                  OR epoch_seconds - previous_epoch > 1 * 3600.0
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS data_segment
  FROM prior
),
valid AS (
  SELECT * FROM prior_groups WHERE value IS NOT NULL
),
rates AS (
  SELECT valid.*,
    (epoch_seconds - previous_epoch) / 3600.0 AS dt_hours,
    ABS(value - previous_value) AS delta
  FROM valid
),
flagged AS (
  SELECT rates.*,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN previous_epoch IS NULL OR epoch_seconds - previous_epoch > 1 * 3600.0 THEN 0
      WHEN dt_hours IS NULL OR dt_hours <= 0.0 THEN 0
      WHEN delta / dt_hours > (3.333333 * 100 / 100.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS over_rate
  FROM rates
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT flagged.*,
    COALESCE(LAG(over_rate) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds), 0) AS previous_over_rate
  FROM flagged
),
base AS (
  SELECT lagged.*,
    CAST(CASE WHEN over_rate = 1 AND previous_over_rate = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS INT) AS raw_fault,
    CASE WHEN next_epoch IS NULL OR next_epoch <= epoch_seconds THEN 0.0
         WHEN next_epoch - epoch_seconds > 1 * 3600.0 THEN 0.0
         ELSE next_epoch - epoch_seconds END AS held_seconds
  FROM lagged
),
streak_groups AS (
  SELECT base.*,
    COALESCE(LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id ORDER BY epoch_seconds), 0) AS previous_raw_fault
  FROM base
),
streaks AS (
  SELECT streak_groups.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (raw_fault = 1 AND previous_raw_fault = 0) OR raw_fault = 0
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id, data_segment ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_group
  FROM streak_groups
),
confirmed_rows AS (
  SELECT streaks.*,
    SUM(CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, series_id, data_segment, streak_group
      ORDER BY epoch_seconds ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS fault_streak_seconds
  FROM streaks
),
final AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, epoch_seconds AS segment_epoch,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND fault_streak_seconds >= 600 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed,
    held_seconds
  FROM confirmed_rows WHERE held_seconds > 0
)
SELECT equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, CAST(segment_epoch AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS ts_epoch, confirmed, held_seconds FROM final WHERE held_seconds > 0 ORDER BY equipment_id, series_id, sensor_role, segment_epoch

-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- pid_hunt_1.sql — Suspected control-output hunting (rolling 1h metrics)
-- Matches pandas hunting_fault_mask: TV / span / cycles / reversals over
-- WINDOW_HOURS. The detection window is still a row frame (WINDOW_ROWS).
-- Fault hours integrate eligible forward deltas and do not add a phantom
-- interval after the last sample. 12 / 11
-- are derived from WINDOW_HOURS + POLL_SECONDS (literal ROWS bounds).
-- Inputs are fractions 0-1 (input_contract.sql); the control output is converted to percent points (x 100)
-- exactly here, once, because the *_PCT parameters (span, deadband, total variation) are percent points.
WITH h AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CASE
      WHEN oa_damper_pct IS NOT NULL THEN
        oa_damper_pct * 100.0
      WHEN clg_valve_pct IS NOT NULL THEN
        clg_valve_pct * 100.0
      WHEN htg_valve_pct IS NOT NULL THEN
        htg_valve_pct * 100.0
      WHEN damper_pct IS NOT NULL THEN
        damper_pct * 100.0
      ELSE NULL
    END AS out_pct,
    LAG(
      CASE
        WHEN oa_damper_pct IS NOT NULL THEN
          oa_damper_pct * 100.0
        WHEN clg_valve_pct IS NOT NULL THEN
          clg_valve_pct * 100.0
        WHEN htg_valve_pct IS NOT NULL THEN
          htg_valve_pct * 100.0
        WHEN damper_pct IS NOT NULL THEN
          damper_pct * 100.0
        ELSE NULL
      END
    ) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc) AS prev_out,
    COALESCE(loop_enabled, 1.0) AS loop_on,
    CASE
      WHEN fan_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN fan_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_cmd > 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 1
    END AS fan_on
  FROM history
),
deltas AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN prev_out IS NULL OR out_pct IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN ABS(out_pct - prev_out) >= 1 THEN out_pct - prev_out
      ELSE 0.0
    END AS sig_delta
  FROM h
),
steps AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN sig_delta IS NULL THEN 0
      ELSE ABS(sig_delta)
    END AS abs_step,
    CASE
      WHEN sig_delta IS NULL OR sig_delta = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN LAG(sig_delta) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc) IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN LAG(sig_delta) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN sig_delta * LAG(sig_delta) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc) < 0 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS reversal_event
  FROM deltas
),
win AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    out_pct,
    fan_on,
    loop_on,
    COUNT(out_pct) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS n_samples,
    SUM(abs_step) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS tv,
    MAX(out_pct) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    )
      - MIN(out_pct) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS span,
    SUM(reversal_event) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS reversals
  FROM steps
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(fan_on, 0) = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN loop_on IS NOT NULL AND loop_on <= 0.05 THEN 0
      WHEN out_pct IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN n_samples < CAST(CEIL(12 * 80 / 100.0) AS INT) THEN 0
      WHEN span < 20 THEN 0
      WHEN tv < 500 THEN 0
      WHEN span <= 0 THEN 0
      WHEN (tv / (2.0 * NULLIF(span, 0))) < 2.5 THEN 0
      WHEN reversals < 4 THEN 0
      ELSE 1
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM win
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN confirmed = 1 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS fault_pct
FROM final
GROUP BY equipment_id;

-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- fc4_os_hunting.sql — PID hunting (operating-state oscillation), GL36 fault 4
-- ΔOS > ΔOSmax during the clock hour: count how many times the AHU *enters* each
-- operating state within the hour and flag the whole hour when any state is
-- entered more than DELTA_OS_MAX times.
-- Operating states: 1 = min OA / heating, 2 = economizer, 3 = mechanical cooling
-- (0 = fan off, not counted).
WITH h AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    oa_damper_pct AS oa_d,
    clg_valve_pct AS clg,
    CASE
      WHEN fan_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_status > 0.05 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END
      WHEN fan_cmd IS NULL THEN NULL
      ELSE fan_cmd
    END AS fan,
    CASE
      WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN 1
      WHEN fan_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN fan_cmd IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_cmd > 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      ELSE 1
    END AS fan_on
  FROM history
),
modes AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    DATE_TRUNC('hour', timestamp_utc) AS clock_hour,
    CASE
      WHEN fan IS NULL OR fan < 0.01 THEN 0
      WHEN clg IS NOT NULL AND clg > 0.1 THEN 3
      WHEN oa_d IS NOT NULL AND oa_d > 0.5 THEN 2
      ELSE 1
    END AS op_mode
  FROM h
),
entries AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    clock_hour,
    op_mode,
    CASE
      WHEN op_mode = 0 THEN 0
      WHEN LAG(op_mode) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc) IS NULL THEN 0
      WHEN op_mode <> LAG(op_mode) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS is_entry
  FROM modes
),
hourly AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_entry = 1 AND op_mode = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, clock_hour) AS entries_min_oa,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_entry = 1 AND op_mode = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, clock_hour) AS entries_econ,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_entry = 1 AND op_mode = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id, clock_hour) AS entries_mech
  FROM entries
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN entries_min_oa > 5 THEN 1
      WHEN entries_econ > 5 THEN 1
      WHEN entries_mech > 5 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS INT) AS raw_fault
  FROM hourly
),
elapsed_hold AS (
  -- Forward sample-and-hold. A gap longer than MAX_GAP_HOURS is unknown:
  -- it is not fault time, not covered time, and it breaks confirmation.
  -- The last sample has no forward interval.
  SELECT
    stepped.*,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds IS NULL
        OR stepped.dt_seconds <= 0.0
        OR stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN stepped.dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS gap_after
  FROM (
    SELECT
      src.*,
      EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        LEAD(src.timestamp_utc) OVER (
          PARTITION BY src.equipment_id ORDER BY src.timestamp_utc
        ) - src.timestamp_utc
      )) AS dt_seconds
    FROM base src
  ) stepped
),
lagged AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN raw_fault = LAG(raw_fault) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
       AND COALESCE(LAG(gap_after) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc), 0) = 0
      THEN 0 ELSE 1
    END AS is_new_streak
  FROM elapsed_hold
),
grp AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(is_new_streak)
      OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS streak_id
  FROM lagged
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    SUM(held_seconds) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id, streak_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS streak_elapsed
  FROM grp
),
final AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    held_seconds,
    CASE WHEN raw_fault = 1 AND streak_elapsed >= 3600 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS confirmed
  FROM ranked
)
, cov AS (
  SELECT equipment_id,
    100.0 * AVG(CAST(COALESCE(fan_on, 1) AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS cov_pct
  FROM h
  GROUP BY equipment_id
)
SELECT
  f.equipment_id,
  CASE
    WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN SUM(CASE WHEN f.confirmed = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0
    WHEN MAX(c.cov_pct) < 5 THEN 0.0
    ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN f.confirmed = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0
  END AS fault_hours,
  SUM(f.held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  CASE
    WHEN 1 < 0.5 THEN 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.confirmed = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(f.held_seconds), 0.0)
    WHEN MAX(c.cov_pct) < 5 THEN 0.0
    ELSE 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN f.confirmed = 1 THEN f.held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(f.held_seconds), 0.0)
  END AS fault_pct
FROM final f
LEFT JOIN cov c ON f.equipment_id = c.equipment_id
GROUP BY f.equipment_id;

  SELECT

    timestamp_utc,
    fan_status,
    pump_status,
    chiller_status,
    fan_cmd AS fan

proof AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,

      WHEN fan_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN fan_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN pump_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN pump_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
      WHEN chiller_status IS NOT NULL THEN CASE WHEN chiller_status > 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

),

      THEN 0.0
      ELSE stepped.dt_seconds

-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- FCU-SENSOR-NULL — own zone setpoint exists while a mapped zone sensor is predominantly null.
-- The runner rewrites this file to zero hours when zone_t is absent from history.
-- Null time and eligible time are eligible forward deltas. A long gap is unknown.
WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    zone_air_temp_sp,
    zone_t,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
      - timestamp_utc
    )) AS dt_seconds
  FROM history
),
held AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    zone_air_temp_sp,
    zone_t,
    CASE
      WHEN dt_seconds IS NULL OR dt_seconds <= 0.0 OR dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds
  FROM ordered
),
coverage AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN zone_air_temp_sp IS NOT NULL THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) AS eligible_seconds,
    SUM(CASE
      WHEN zone_air_temp_sp IS NOT NULL AND zone_t IS NULL THEN held_seconds
      ELSE 0.0
    END) AS null_seconds
  FROM held
  GROUP BY equipment_id
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  CASE
    WHEN eligible_seconds > 0.0
     AND null_seconds / eligible_seconds >= 0.9
    THEN null_seconds / 3600.0
    ELSE 0.0
  END AS fault_hours,
  eligible_seconds / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  CASE
    WHEN eligible_seconds > 0.0
     AND null_seconds / eligible_seconds >= 0.9
    THEN 100.0 * null_seconds / eligible_seconds
    ELSE 0.0
  END AS fault_pct
FROM coverage;

-- FCU-DEADBAND — pass-through FCU setpoints remain site-native Celsius.

WITH ordered AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    cooling_sp,
    heating_sp,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
      - timestamp_utc
    )) AS dt_seconds
  FROM history
),

  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    cooling_sp,
    heating_sp,
    CASE
      WHEN dt_seconds IS NULL OR dt_seconds <= 0.0 OR dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds
  FROM ordered
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE
    WHEN cooling_sp IS NOT NULL AND heating_sp IS NOT NULL
     AND cooling_sp - heating_sp < 1
    THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0
  END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE
    WHEN cooling_sp IS NOT NULL AND heating_sp IS NOT NULL
     AND cooling_sp - heating_sp < 1
    THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0
  END) / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS fault_pct

-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- FCU-MODE-CYCLE — cumulative heat/cool mode transitions in the analysis window.
-- Hours are eligible forward deltas after the change count reaches MODE_CHANGES.
WITH modes AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    CASE
      WHEN clg_valve_pct IS NOT NULL AND clg_valve_pct > 0.1 THEN -1
      WHEN htg_valve_pct IS NOT NULL AND htg_valve_pct > 0.1 THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS mode
  FROM history
),
active_modes AS (
  SELECT equipment_id, timestamp_utc, mode
  FROM modes
  WHERE mode <> 0
),
changes AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    timestamp_utc,
    mode,
    CASE
      WHEN LAG(mode) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc) IS NOT NULL
       AND mode <> LAG(mode) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
      THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END AS changed,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc)
      - timestamp_utc
    )) AS dt_seconds
  FROM active_modes
),
cumulative AS (
  SELECT
    equipment_id,
    SUM(changed) OVER (
      PARTITION BY equipment_id ORDER BY timestamp_utc ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) AS change_count,
    CASE
      WHEN dt_seconds IS NULL OR dt_seconds <= 0.0 OR dt_seconds > (1 * 3600.0)
      THEN 0.0
      ELSE dt_seconds
    END AS held_seconds
  FROM changes
)
SELECT
  equipment_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN change_count >= 4 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END) / 3600.0 AS fault_hours,
  SUM(held_seconds) / 3600.0 AS covered_hours,
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN change_count >= 4 THEN held_seconds ELSE 0.0 END)
    / NULLIF(SUM(held_seconds), 0.0) AS fault_pct
FROM cumulative
GROUP BY equipment_id;

-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- util_monthly_fault.sql — BAS monthly kWh vs utility monthly bills (% deviation)
-- Storage is SI (metric-c-v2): energy is kWh; UTIL_PCT_ERR is a percent of utility kWh.
WITH bas_raw AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp_utc,
    kwh,
    electric_kw,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp_utc) - timestamp_utc
    )) AS dt_seconds
  FROM history
  WHERE kwh IS NOT NULL OR electric_kw IS NOT NULL
),
bas_monthly AS (
  SELECT
    to_char(timestamp_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM') AS billing_period,
    SUM(
      COALESCE(
        CAST(kwh AS DOUBLE PRECISION),
        CASE
          WHEN dt_seconds > 0.0 AND dt_seconds <= (1 * 3600.0)
          THEN CAST(electric_kw AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * dt_seconds / 3600.0
          ELSE 0.0
        END,
        0.0
      )
    ) AS bas_kwh
  FROM bas_raw
  GROUP BY 1
),
util AS (
  SELECT
    billing_period,
    CAST(kwh AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS util_kwh
  FROM utility_monthly
  WHERE kwh IS NOT NULL
),
joined AS (
  SELECT
    u.billing_period,
    u.util_kwh,
    COALESCE(b.bas_kwh, 0.0) AS bas_kwh,
    CASE
      WHEN u.util_kwh IS NULL OR u.util_kwh <= 0 THEN 0
      WHEN ABS(COALESCE(b.bas_kwh, 0.0) - u.util_kwh) / u.util_kwh * 100.0 > 10
      THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS raw_fault
  FROM util u
  LEFT JOIN bas_monthly b ON b.billing_period = u.billing_period
)
SELECT
  '__UTIL_MONTHLY__' AS equipment_id,
  CAST(SUM(raw_fault) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * 720.0 AS fault_hours,
  NULL::double precision AS covered_hours,
  NULL::double precision AS fault_pct
FROM joined;

-- PostgreSQL adaptation. Render numeric template parameters with render_rule.py.
-- Inputs must be scoped to one tenant/site and cadence; see README.md.
-- util_interval_fault.sql — BAS 15m vs utility interval (rolling MAE proxy)
-- Storage is SI (metric-c-v2): energy is kWh (canonical interval_energy); UTIL_INTERVAL_MAE is kWh.
WITH bas_raw AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp_utc,
    kwh,
    electric_kw,
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
      LEAD(timestamp_utc) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp_utc) - timestamp_utc
    )) AS dt_seconds
  FROM history
  WHERE kwh IS NOT NULL OR electric_kw IS NOT NULL
),
bas AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp_utc,
    COALESCE(
      CAST(kwh AS DOUBLE PRECISION),
      CASE
        WHEN dt_seconds > 0.0 AND dt_seconds <= (1 * 3600.0)
        THEN CAST(electric_kw AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * dt_seconds / 3600.0
        ELSE 0.0
      END
    ) AS bas_kwh
  FROM bas_raw
),
util AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp_utc,
    CAST(kwh AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS util_kwh
  FROM utility_interval
  WHERE kwh IS NOT NULL
),
joined AS (
  SELECT
    b.timestamp_utc,
    ABS(COALESCE(b.bas_kwh, 0.0) - COALESCE(u.util_kwh, 0.0)) AS abs_err
  FROM bas b
  INNER JOIN util u ON b.timestamp_utc = u.timestamp_utc
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
  AVG(abs_err) AS mae
  FROM joined
)
SELECT
  '__UTIL_INTERVAL__' AS equipment_id,
  CASE
    WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM util) = 0 THEN 0.0
    WHEN mae > 5 THEN 720.0
    ELSE 0.0
  END AS fault_hours,
  NULL::double precision AS covered_hours,
  NULL::double precision AS fault_pct
FROM agg;
UTIL-INTERVAL.timeline_reason: no per-row confirmed flag (the rule aggregates a ratio, count or window statistic)
